timeline.title: First lines of code
timeline.subtitle: HTML & CSS foundations
timeline.description: Started self-teaching frontend development. Learned semantic markup, the box model, and how to build a page from scratch without a framework.

timeline.title: Layouts that adapt
timeline.subtitle: Responsive design
timeline.description: Moved past fixed-width pages. Practised fluid layouts, media queries, and CSS Grid and Flexbox so the same markup holds up from phone to desktop.

timeline.title: Making pages respond
timeline.subtitle: JavaScript interactivity
timeline.description: Added behaviour on top of static markup: DOM manipulation, event handling, and fetching JSON so content is rendered from data instead of being hardcoded.

timeline.title: Building for everyone
timeline.subtitle: Accessibility
timeline.description: Learned to treat accessibility as a requirement rather than a cleanup task: semantic structure, keyboard navigation, focus management, and honouring prefers-reduced-motion.

timeline.title: Structure over repetition
timeline.subtitle: Design systems
timeline.description: Replaced one-off styling with design tokens and reusable component styles so the site stays consistent and stays easy to change.

timeline.title: This portfolio
timeline.subtitle: First passion project
timeline.description: The project you are looking at. Built to track my own work and to present it honestly rather than to perform for an audience.

tools.name: Git
tools.description: Version control for everything here: branching, and writing commits that explain why a change was made rather than just what changed.

tools.name: GitHub
tools.description: Where this portfolio is hosted remotely and versioned, and where changes are kept track of before they land.

tools.name: VS Code
tools.description: Where all of this gets written: workspace settings, debugging, and the integrated terminal and source control.
